review_description: Extremely happy with the honest advice on a system we needed to install. Also they where very informative and installation was first class by the team.

I requested six proposals for my solar upgrade and received six different solutions.  Several were clearly cookie cutter one size fits all proposals that got binned immediately, one didn't even listen to the brief,  then there are the installers who hear the basics then jump in before hearing the detail - Note to installers, if you can't be bothered even listening to what the customer is trying to achieve, what is the likelihood of them getting the solution they want?  This is where Greenline Solar stood out and secured my business.  During the development stage, Toby listened to what I wanted to achieve beyond basics of capacity, came up with a solution, put it to me to scrutinise, I got to ask questions that sometime required research on his part and eventually a shortlist of three proposals for me to choose from.  It was this level of collaboration, patience and commitment that got my signature.  Every part of the system could be qualified and justified.  Initially I thought I'd get a few quotes and boom job done, but the research phase took a lot longer than anticipated and I wouldn't change that because the result is fit for purpose.  After the groundwork  is done, the install is easy and the result is all but guaranteed.Jake and his install team turned up as planned, on time and worked like champs on what was in places a challenging install.  They asked questions rather than making assumptions, ran to schedule and cleaned up after themselves.  What more could you ask?If you take away one thing from this review it's this.  Any installer can install whatever panels, inverter, battery etc you spec based on your research or their opinion, then walk away - tick the boxes and away they go.  For some this is ok.  What you will get from Greenline Solar is that extra effort, time, commitment and integrity.  I'd use them again in a heartbeat and recommend them without reservation.

The Green Line Solar team was excellent throughout the whole process, from quoting on-site to delivery and providing me with a manual after commissioning. I have worked with many trades, and the Green Line team is very neat, clean, and clearly takes pride in the work they do. I felt confident during installation, as the communication was clear and concise. Any adjustments were advised and sought my permission before continuing.I was very happy with the backup and EV charging testing before handover. The filing of the necessary paperwork was quite seamless and well prepared, making admin a breeze. A big thank you to the Green Line Solar team!

I highly recommend Green Line Solar — a true 5-star experience from start to finish! Toby and Jake were an absolute pleasure to work with. Unlike some other companies, they never used high-pressure sales tactics. Toby took the time to patiently answer all of my questions, making sure I felt informed and confident every step of the way. On installation day, Jake and his team were efficient, professional, and made the whole process completely stress-free.If you’re considering going solar, Green Line Solar is the team to go with.

From the first phone call, Toby was very helpful, knowledgeable and responsive to our needs and queries. Explaining systems and requirements to us in a clear and patient manner that made our decision making process much easier. Also helped us organise a mains upgrade for optimal performance. On installation, Jake and the team were very professional and thorough, with great attention to detail and a quality result. From start to finish, the team were polite, punctual and available to answer questions. We are very happy with our system, and the process and journey from start to finish. We have seen a massive reduction in power bills and have already been consistently over 95% off grid due to the system’s efficiency. We highly recommend Green Line Solar for your solar and battery installation. Rob

I recently had my solar system installed and activated by Green Line Solar, and I’m very impressed with the whole process. Toby and Jake were professional, efficient, and explained everything clearly. From the installation to the final activation and handover, everything was smooth and well organised.The team handled the federal rebate requirements without stress on my end, and communication was excellent throughout. The workmanship is neat, and the system was up and running exactly as promised.I would highly recommend Green Line Solar to anyone looking for reliable and professional solar installation.

After a lot of investigation online we chose Green Line Solar to install our rooftop PV and battery systems.  Throughout the process Toby and Jake from Green Line Solar provided clear advice and a very competitive quotation. Their subsequent attention to completing the installation in good time and of an excellent standard, was exemplary. We have no hesitation recommending Green Line Solar, and have done so to our family and friends.

I had Toby & Jake install my solar system almost 2 years ago. I was so impressed by the service (Toby took a lot of time to answer my many questions) that I went directly to Green Line Solar when the time came to add a battery. Toby again explained everything in plain language and got me a great deal on my new Sungrow battery.  Jake and his team just finished the install today (about 5 hours work). As always his team were polite, efficient and did a great job. I highly recommend Green Line Solar as they are easy to deal with, take the time to explain how solar works, and do a great job and are not pushy sales people. Thanks again guys

Toby and Jake answered all of my questions and presented me with a range of options bespoke to my property and my energy needs.They conducted a site inspection to verify their design and quickly followed up on any issues I had.They kept me in the loop at all times during the process.Would highly recommend Toby and Jake at Green Line Solar.

The service provided by the installer (Toby and Jake +) was excellent. They certainly knew their business. All quotes were well laid out and made the process easier. Work was done 3 weeks early due to a cancellation which suited us greatly.Personnel service was excellent - on site inspection done before installation was very informative, workers arrived on time and got on with the work promptly (they were here for 7-8 hours), very clean around the site.Information back to us re the components was great.

After a month of research and quotes with several solar installers, we finally settled on Green Line Solar for a 11.4kw PV system. We are extremely pleased with the whole process and Green Line Solar's professional workmanship. Cannot recommend them highly enough!Absolutely top-notch pre- and post-installation sales and service from Toby, and immaculate installation by Jake and his team over 2.5 days.As the first point of contact, Toby was professional and informative in providing us with quotes that would currently suit and future-proof our property. As part of this process, he conducted a site visit to ensure the PV placement was feasible on our roof. Engagement with him post-installation continued to remain professional and prompt, with Toby being very patient with my never ending questions on monitoring.In terms of the install - what more can I say, but that Jake and his team were first class. The install was measured and not rushed, and the quality of the workmanship was impeccable. Shout out, in particular, on the installation of the Fronius inverter and the monitoring box in the garage which was perfectly aligned and straight. Communication was regular, with Jake keeping us up-to-date throughout each day, and his team were a friendly bunch!Any future additional works for an EV charger or battery will definitely be through them again!
From the start Toby was great to deal with and gave great advise , Then when he came to install Jake and the team were great super clean and gave plenty of information on where they were up to.

We could not be happier with Toby and the team at Green Line Solar on my recent Solar upgrade. We were coming off the old 66c Feed in Tarriff on a 3Kw system and have recently upgraded and installed a new 13.2 Kw system. It was a seamless process from Quoting to installation and Toby was always available to answer my multiple questions (Trust me, I had lots of them).Great Customer Service is hard to find these days, but these guys have it in spades and once the system was up and running they talked me through and helped set up the app for me to be able to track my systems performance and output.And I am so glad they handled all the grid connection for me, as I think i would have struggled with it.Will definitely recommend these guys to my Family and friends looking to install a Solar system, and after receiving my first bill since the install, they were spot on with their calculations.Thanks so much guys, we couldn't be happier.

Very good communicators.  Easy to work with.  Professional standard of workmanship.  Did a great job to tailor the system to our specific requirements (no forced labour poly silicon).  Optimised the design very to provide best value for money.  Highly recommended.

System: 39x Jinko 440w panels, 10kW Sungrow inverter, 12.8kWh Sungrow modular battery.When looking for quotes,  I spoke to several companies, and decided o go with Green Line Solar as they had really good pricing and speaking to Toby was straightforward and easy. He spoke in a way that was to my level of understanding and gave me a few different options, which was exactly what I was after. Green Line Solar handled most of the paperwork, with only Solar Victoria (for rebate, loans) needing to be done by myself online. The install was originally scheduled for early Feb the following year, but due to a supplier stock issue for a different brand, they were able to move up my install before Christmas, and I got some bonus STCs!On inspecting the house, Jake identified the best position for the inverter and battery, which happed to be where an old broken gas ducted heater was situated. He organized for a plumber to come out to disconnect the gas line and remove the heater. As part of the install, Jake provided concrete slabs and a cement sheet to cover the hole in the wall from the heater. The install happened over two wet days, and Jake and the guys on the roof took care to replace tiles each time it started raining. They kept me informed of when they needed to turn off the power, and kept that to a minimum. The install is very neat and tidy, the cable runs immaculate. Jake performed all the electrical checks, explained the changes to the switchboard, and introduced me to the Sungrow iSolarCloud app.I am very happy with the system, and all my dealings with Green Line Solar. Highly recommended!

I can't speak highly enough of the people at Green Line Solar. I had sought quotes for roof top solar from several companies, and in the end decided to go with these guys. I felt they really listened to what it was I wanted to achieve within my budget, and based on this, they came up with a few different options for me to choose from. They were happy to talk through these with me, and in the end, were able to tweak one of them to come up with the system that was ultimately installed. Throughout the process they were happy to answer any questions I threw at them. Their explanations regarding what I would be able to achieve with my installation and of the installation process itself were clear and accurate.We had booked in a tentative date for installation but were able to have the system installed ahead of schedule, which was a bonus for me. On the day of installation the team arrived on time (to the minute - precisely!) which is no mean feat considering they were travelling through traffic from the other side of Melbourne. The installation was completed in the time frame quoted. Throughout the installation I was kept informed about the process (eg when the mains power needed to be switched off). They did not leave any mess for me to clean up afterwards. In fact, aside from the lovely new solar panels on my roof, you wouldn't know they had been.Overall the customer service throughout the process has been excellent. They have taken care of everything at every step of the way and have delivered me a system that meets my needs and which is within the budget I had set myself. I have absolutely no hesitation in recommending Green Line Solar.

Despite having done my due diligence and considerable research, I consider myself very fortunate to have settled on Green Line Solar to carry out my installation.  The whole process was seamless.  Toby was a delight to deal with and he guided me patiently and politely through my first foray into the complex world of domestic solar.  His level of communication and advice was brilliant as was his ultimate presentation on the system that would best suit my needs.  His quote was thorough, professionally presented and extremely competitive and fair.On the day of the installation Jake and his team turned up on time and worked solidly on what was a hot, difficult day to get the job completed in one day.  They were the quintessential professionals who worked hard to leave a minimal visual impact and footprint, making sure the cabling and infrastructure were hidden away wherever possible and leaving the job in a clean and tidy state.   Their workmanship was first rate, even the independent inspection officer commented about what a great job they do, especially the little things.I am extremely happy with the job that Green Line did and am happy recommend them most highly.

We had a 8kw system installed and the team from Green Line Solar was excellent.  Toby came out for a site inspection as this was important to us as we can go through and discuss what we are looking for and ensure we can have an aesthetically installed system which was very important to us. Toby was very patient with us, provide great advice, not pushy and allowed us time to discuss and think through before we reverted to him after quite a long pause to finalise.Once we gave Toby our "go-ahead", installation went very promptly. Jake his business partner and installer is also amazing, you can tell he does the installation work with a passion, providing you a run down at the start of the job on the install and reconfirm what has been discussed with Toby about the install and what he understands of our needs and preferences. Together, with the apprentice he has helping him on the job, they did an amazing job and they went beyond to ensure we have an aesthetically installed system. They delivered and the team ensured the place was tidy upon completion.After the install Toby organised all the connection, all done promptly. Their customer service was excellent. You can see they do this for a living with a passion. Now that our solar panels are up and running, we are thrilled with the results.  We wouldn't hesitate to recommend Green Line Solar to our family and friends or anyone considering installing Solar.

We had an 11kw solar system installed with a 16kw battery which has been fantastic so far. The whole process from start to finish with Toby and Jake felt effortless, professional and simple. From Toby’s knowledge and advice to Jake’s attention to detail during the install. They both were always happy to answer any questions. Grid connection went ahead with very little input needed from me. If you want an honest team that deliver, Toby and Jake from GREENLINE Solar are your best pick.

Toby and his team were extremely professional and proficient. The whole process from start to finish was seamless.  Each step was completed as promised on time. All staff were professional in their approach and friendly and manner. We highly recommend this company if you’re thinking about Solar installation.

Green Line Solar is an excellent solar installation company to deal with. They listen to what you aim to achieve and promptly provide a quotation listing a few options for you to consider which is followed up with a phone call giving you with the opportunity to ask questions and discuss the best option for you. I found the installer to be punctual and polite. At completion of the installation, I was shown how I could monitor solar production and usage via an app and further details regarding this was emailed to me. Green Line Solar handle all of the paperwork to organise connection to the grid after installation making the process trouble free and seamless.
Green line solar were fantastic to deal with, clear information and delivery of the installation within the time frame given.Quality tradesmen and a pleasure to deal with.I would highly recommend.

Loved everything about dealing with Green Line Solar. During the initial contact and quote, Toby took the time to come to us and understand our situation and suggest an approach that would best suit us (didn’t try to upsell us into something we didn’t need). Toby was also extremely helpful with information and suggestions leading up to the install.We needed some minor electrical work done on our switchboard prior to install (to enable the features we wanted) and Toby and Jake were excellent in allowing us to have that done through our regular electrician, speaking to them and working with them to have everything ready for install day.Jake and the install team were elite.Punctual, friendly, professional, neat, tidy, and they cared about their work-went over and above in making sure the system looked awesome. This was important for us as one of the strings of panels was on the ‘front’ of the house.The install was also impressively quick, with panels installed and producing power for our home on the same day. We also had a Hot Water Heat Pump installed on the same day which was great to just have the one day of disruption, and great to have it all organised through the one supplier.Post install, the team spent time taking us through the system, how to control/monitor it and, again, went above and beyond with their customer service, helping to me source some additional roof tiles (expected a few would break and didn’t have any spares-yay for having ‘unique’ tiles!Overall, Green Line Solar went above and beyond several times and my praise for them couldn’t be any higher.

I highly recommend the team at Green Line Solar. They installed an 11.88kW system on our home as part of recent renovations. Toby really helped us achieve our goal of maximising the size of the system given the limitations imposed by our roof space, in particular balancing the efficiency of the system through use of MPPTs in a way that other solar companies did not consider or seem interested in delving into. Additionally they identified and notified us that the system was powered off when separate electricians had forgotten to turn the inverters back on after they’d completed separate work post install. I really appreciate the attention to detail and friendly and open communication, with Toby explaining the particular merits of different proposals and answering any questions I had.
Punctual, neat and tidy, answered silly questions.  Feel sorry for the apprentice that found out he was scared of heights, but everything else just went right.

Green Line Solar were the only Installers to visit the site - this was a major reason for finally choosing them. I was able to meet the staff & ask relevant questions. They were prompt, courteous & professional in all aspects of the job. They assisted with the rebate paperwork & helped with the grid connection after the install. I would recommend Green Line Solar.
Fantastic end to end project and responses. Great outcome. Happy with our new installation.

Recommendation from friend. Team were easy to deal with, all questions answered before and after purchase (the latter is not always the case!). Not the cheapest quote I received, but no regrets after quoting process, quality of work, followup customer support and overall no bullsh@t experience.

We are extremely happy with the solar system from Green Line.  The customer service was excellent, including giving options and recommendations on what they felt was the best product for our roof and design.  The price was very reasonable (cheaper than our other quote), install ran smoothly, highly professional, and reliable. The system is working really well.  We are very happy with the experience and would highly recommend Green Line Solar.

I set up an appointment with Toby for a quote which occurred within a couple of days.  He visited the site & I had my initial detailed quotes of a variety of systems the next day.Upon acceptance of the final quote, a date for installation was agreed, which was about six weeks after acceptance, & I was contacted a couple of days before that date to confirm all was OK.Installation was carried out quickly & efficiently.Toby assisted in setting me up on the Fronius app to monitor the systemAll the paperwork for STCs & rebates was handled by Green Line apart from my initial application for the state govt rebate which I had to do in my own name.Green Line has sent the required notifications to my retailer & supplier.All in all a smooth & competent exercise.

Just completed all formalities with respect to my Solar PV installation, with the confirmation from the energy retailer that I will see details my electricity usage, grid feed-ins etc in my next bill. The installation was brought to fruition with the kind help of Toby and Jake of Green Line Solar - a very satisfying experience. Satisfying because everything was so seamless and the knowledge that you are dealing with professionals as opposed to cowboys who are all over the place these days. The design process with Toby was good, with my installation ending up as a 10.56 kW system, as opposed to the average 6.6kW system for a small household - the benefits of which I am seeing already. Price wise I think it was cost effective -not cheap- although Toby insists that I got a very good deal!! The project concluded with Jake doing the installation, personally by him - no subcontractors, the provision of all documentation, and follow up with the energy distributor and the retailer. The only warning I have is that they have become very busy, and therefore to plan ahead and watch out as the lag time for the installation may take a few weeks extra from the time the quote is agreed; otherwise a very good experience.
Toby was extremely helpful and friendly to communicate, he also responses promptly.Jake and his installation team was excellent and installed the whole system under the rain.

Toby did a great presentation and quotation for us. He is always polite and respectful even when handling basic questions from us. He suggested the solar system requirements for us the way he believed we would need and was quick and diligent with alternative systems or configurations following our curiosities.Toby was very patient with us and allowed us time to discuss ourselves and think through before we reverted to him after quite a pause. He remembered our requirements and even suggested he get his installation supervisor to visit our place including looking above our ceiling to analyse any savings before finalising our quote.Once we gave Toby our "go-ahead", installation went very promptly and in my opinion professionally, installers were very respectful and tidy. Jake, the installation supervisor helped us set up the inverter monitoring app on our phone and guided us on the usage.After the installation, Toby got in touch and asked us for feedback on installation, and helped set up grid connections without our prompting.

We had a fantastic experience with Green Line Solar from the very first phonecall right through to after installation. Toby spent so much time chatting through our options with me and came across so genuine in his interest and desire to do the best for us in good quality Solar without blowing the budget. Toby was so full of helpful info and never patronising. Very personable and went above and beyond to do a site inspection when we weren’t even 100% sure when we’d commit. We had shading issues and I believe these guys did a thorough design with shade analysis for us. I had absolutely no hesitation in going with them. They were open to discussion about cheaper brands if our budget needed but were so thorough in explaining rationale around why we’d benefit from paying slightly more. Once signed up, the paperwork process was seamless. We barely had to do anything. The gvmt subsidy stuff went through so quick. For the installation, Jake and the guys were very professional, on time, tidy and efficient. Paperwork easy. Electrician check done the next day! And final paperwork for energy retailer done the day after. Very caring, small scale team who genuinely care.

I could not be happier with my solar panel install and working with the team at Green Line Solar! From quotation to installation Green Line  have answered any and all question I may have had. The workmanship was impeccable and the installers were extremely knowledgeable, professional and tidy. They organised every aspect of the installation including rebates and grid connection so I didn’t have to worry about anything. Highly recommend Green Line !

Green Line Solar were great installers. Our roof was quite challenging due to it's design but they managed to get it all done in under 2 days. Service was really good, I felt that they were very honest about what would work best and provided us with very accurate estimates for the power we would be able to produce. We are very happy with the install and the product that we purchased. Would highly recommend Green Line Solar.
Toby gave a lot of time to answer any questions.No fuss solutions and robust PV design.Pre-install site inspection validated the design assumptions.Professional installation and quality tidy ups.

I contacted Green Line Solar because they were rated highly by Solarquotes (https://www.solarquotes.com.au/blog/top-melbourne-solar-installers-2023/ ) and Top 10 Solar Companies (https://www.top10solarcompanies.com.au/melbourne ). They were one of 7 companies I contacted. Similar to other solar companies, Toby gave us an initial quote based on the size of our roof, but said he would need to visit our house to look at the roof, before he would finalise the quote. Toby was the only installer who came out and looked at our roof before the quote. As a result of looking at the roof, he said the job would take longer because the tiles were flat. He factored this added time into a revised quote.This visit to our home let us talk to Toby for a while. Talking face-to-face to Toby instead of dealing with salesmen over the phone, I gained confidence in the company I would be using. He mentioned that Jake (partner) and he believe that their mission statement is to ensure there are no ‘winners’ or ‘losers’, but that everyone knows what they are buying and pays the appropriate amount for a quality install, reliability and support long term. His quote was competitive with all the quotes I received, even before adding in the cost of a second day. Other companies had a caveat in their proposal that the added work to grind the tiles were included in their price. Since you don’t get something for nothing, I was Impressed with Toby’s being up front about the cost of the project.Jake and his team did a great job installing the panels. In addition to installing the panels and inverter, they did little things that made us feel even more comfortable about the people we chose for the job: Examples of going the extra mile were to make sure the inverter on the west side of the house was protected from the sun; and to move to TV antenna to avoid bird droppings on panels.The bottom line is I highly recommend doing business with Green Line Solar.

Toby was fantastic to deal with throughout the whole process. Once contacted, and he had a handle on our requirements, a range of high-quality quotes were provided. We discussed the factors and settled on a solid mix of hardware. Toby then made a site-visit to check the actual roof and inverter locations. This was a definite point of difference from our previous experiences, where the quotes were all based on satellite imagery for planning. Jake and his apprentices came out the next week and, over two days, did a great job with the installation of 10 panels on tilts and 10 panels on our Colourbond roof. The conduit and cabling were all neatly laid and well-sealed for a neat appearance. Toby and Jake were both extremely professional, and Prashant completed the final step of the electrical inspection, which got us onto the grid efficiently. Overall, what can be an overwhelming and daunting process was made so easy.

Definitely recommendable team!From the initial consultation to the completion, Toby, Jake and their team did such a great job at my place.When you see that the owners of the business actually came out and did hands-on jobs like measuring & installation etc., you feel you are in a good hands.They do deliver what they promised at the end of the day.

Greenline responded to my online request very quickly, the quote was supplied quickly and most important, accurately. No surprises.The installation was on time, efficient (quicker than estimated) and the guys left our property clean and tidy. I was very impressed with how neat the actual install is finished. It wasn't the easiest access.Toby has been super responsive to any follow up questions and Jake and his team where a delight to have in (and around) our home.

Firstly, our job wasn't your standard run of the mill install - we already had a 10kw solar system installed on our roof a number of years ago by another provider, and due to recent house extensions we wanted to add an additional 10kw system to a new roof, and combine the systems.  This involved upgrading our supply from single phase to three phase, and to further complicate it we also needed our existing panels temporarily removed off our tile roof, allowing us to re-roof it to colourbond as part of our rennovations, and then have it re-instated!Toby and his team were amazing to deal with.  They really cared about the entire end to end process, took the time to understand what we were aiming to achieve, and weren't rushing us in and out like other might have.  Our job was complex and needed coordination and communication over several months, and these guys exceeded my expectations.  They always respond to emails and texts and nothing is too big of a problem to overcome.  They think outside the box and offer up solutions, and when it comes to the quality of the install they are perfectionists!When it came to re-instating the old panels on our new colourbond roof, we chose to slightly relocated them to a much more aesthetically pleasing location and everything is now perfectly lined up.  And, our new roof is a flat roof which means you mostly can't see the new panels that were added but that didn't stop them from measuring and lining everything up to centimetre accuracy anyway!I'm definitely recommending these guys to everyone I speak to.  Thanks again Green Line Solar!

We had a very good experience with Green Line Solar. Toby was very professional, friendly & patient to answer all questions and wait till we decided without many follow-ups. Toby visited our home and provided the accurate quote. Once accepted, scheduling was quick as they could squeeze in our installation sooner than later. Jake & team were so professional and quickly completed the installation (Thanks to Melbourne weather ;) ). Installation was done professionally and it was very neatly done. Inspector also praised the way the installation is done. Very happy with Green Line Solar and they lived upto our expectations.

Green Line Solar did a great job.The quoting process was very thorough with all questions and inquiries explained in detail (great information on what type of inverter would best suit my needs) and all performed in a timely manner.The installation process was excellent, on time, very neat and tidy work.Customer service was very good, followed-up to check on the grid connection.I would highly recommend Green Line Solar for your installation.

The sales quote was smooth, cleared all doubts and answered all queries.Installation staff were punctual, courteous, and did a very neat job. As my TV antenna was in the way they moved it to another location. Very impressed with them.They did all that was required leaving us with no worry.
Greenline were professional, tidy, on time and polite. Thank you to the team.

Sales and quoting, Confirmed quickly and build solution to needs and discussed intricacies of what the setup would look like.Installation other than weather delays went well. A real professional team, they were great and stepped me through what they were doing and also why they were doing it that way.Definitely would choose this team again and recommend them to other people if the need arises.

I got put onto Green Line Solar from a reference from a friend who used them,The quoting phase was seamless, and they offer up a variety of selections for our home usage and to future proof the property.Install was just as easy, they looked after everything, and the workmanship (conduit runs and solar layout)  was extremely neat.They organised the CES and connection to the grid straight away so we started to save $ asap.The ease of communication throughout was refreshing, and the guys were very friendly & genuine. I would highly recommend the team at Green Line Solar.
Arrived on time on the day they said. Polite happy to answer any questions. Explained how the system works.

Very happy with the install. Looks fantastic with the all black panels, and Toby and Jake provided a lot of great suggestions and guidance as to the best set up for our site, which is challenging with shading issues. A little more expensive than some of the cheap options, but with it for the quality of install.

Thanks, Toby, Jake and the boys. Our experience with Green Line Solar was nothing short of exceptional. From the initial consultation to the final installation, every step was handled with professionalism and care. The team was knowledgeable, answering all our questions and guiding us through the process seamlessly. They provided clear timelines and kept us informed at every stage. The installation was efficient and meticulous, with the team respecting our property and ensuring everything was tidy upon completion. Now that our solar panels are up and running, we're thrilled with the results. We wouldn't hesitate to recommend Green Line Solar to our friends or anyone considering solar energy for their home."

The guys at Green Line Solar were fantastic to deal with.Regarding the sales and quoting process, Toby was realistic, polite, and non-pushy. Gave us plenty of time and space to review and think about the quotes we received. Quotes were also easy to read and more importantly, thorough.The installation by Jake and his apprentices was very smooth, pleasant, polite, and tidy as well. The finished product was very pleasing and symmetrical to look at as well. We were very pleased with the outcome of the install, despite having lots of warning labels and stickers all over the place due to regulations (which could not be avoided). We went with the battery and solar option, which had to be done over 2x days, but both days were very pleasant.In terms of customer service, Toby helped come back to tidy up a couple of things and added some additional labels which the inspector requested. So not the touch-and-go kind of company, which was good to know.

Toby was the only installer who came out and looked at our roof before the quote. Others quoted based on Google Earth photos of the house. He answered all of our. questions and we were kept informed of what to expect next during the whole process. Installation went as expected. Happy with Green Line and would recommend!

From the very start Toby patiently worked to design a system that fiitted our requirements due to a very complex situation that took a while to resolve.The install wasn't an easy one and the ingenious solution to put the inverters under our unit was much appreciated.Toby, Jake and crew explained the process, and completed the job in a tidy and efficient manner.The grid connection was staightforward, as was set up of the solar app.We are extremely pleased with our solar system and thoroughly recommend Green Line Solar.

Very happy with the whole quote and installation process with Green Line.Toby is an excellent communicator, takes all calls, really listens and clearly explains the products and options.On installation day Jake talked through the process and ensured the inverter was positioned in an ideal spot.I had received cheaper quotes from 3 other installers but decided to go with Green Line because I could talk directly with the owners, they do not sub-contract out the installation, and they had great reviews on Solar Quotes.
